destinations.name: Merzouga & the Sahara
destinations.description: Open horizons, changing dune colours and a different rhythm after sunset.
destinations.body: Merzouga sits beside the Erg Chebbi dunes in eastern Morocco. Build your visit around time outdoors and a desert overnight, with enough travel days to enjoy the route there.
experiences: Walk beside the dunes in the softer morning light
Discuss a camel ride or a vehicle transfer to camp
Leave an evening free for the desert sky
destinations.planning: Confirm the camp location, bathroom arrangements, transfers and activities in your quote. Marrakech and Fes are both a substantial drive away.

destinations.name: Chefchaouen
destinations.description: Blue-washed lanes and mountain views, with room to simply wander.
destinations.body: Set in the Rif Mountains, Chefchaouen adds a quieter stop to a northern route. Stay overnight to see the lanes at different times of day instead of treating the town as a quick photo stop.
experiences: Explore the medina's blue lanes on foot
Pause at a square for tea and people-watching
Look for views across the rooftops
destinations.planning: Pair Chefchaouen with Fes or an arrival in Tangier. Tell us about mobility needs: the medina has steps and sloping lanes.

destinations.name: Fes
destinations.description: Craft workshops, tiled gateways and the everyday life of a historic medina.
destinations.body: Fes rewards a full day of exploration. Its lanes connect working neighbourhoods, markets and architecture, so a visit is richer when there is time to stop and listen.
experiences: Begin your medina walk at Bab Bou Jeloud
Discover local craft traditions with a city guide
Take time for a lunch break between visits
destinations.planning: Ask for a guided walking day rather than squeezing the city into a transfer afternoon. Comfortable shoes make the uneven streets easier.

destinations.name: Ait Ben Haddou
destinations.description: Earthen architecture, winding paths and a remarkable view over the valley.
destinations.body: Ait Ben Haddou is a natural stop between Marrakech and southern Morocco. The earthen village is best explored on foot, allowing time for the climb and the changing views.
experiences: Follow the paths through the earthen village
Look out over the valley from higher ground
Pair the visit with an overnight near Ouarzazate
destinations.planning: The paths can be steep and exposed to the sun. Plan water, suitable shoes and a visit that fits your walking comfort.

destinations.name: The Atlas Mountains
destinations.description: Mountain roads, terraced valleys and a welcome change of pace.
destinations.body: The Atlas is more than a route to the desert. Add time for a valley stay, village walk or dedicated hiking day, choosing the activity around your interests and ability.
experiences: Stop for wide views along your mountain route
Make time for a guided valley walk
Extend your stay to explore beyond the road
destinations.planning: Mountain weather can affect access and timings. A road crossing is not a trekking itinerary; ask us to plan a separate walking experience if that is your priority.

destinations.name: Marrakech
destinations.description: Warm-toned streets, lively souks and a gateway to the High Atlas.
destinations.body: Give Marrakech time at the beginning or end of your journey. Balance the busy medina with a courtyard break and make space for the city's food, craft and architecture.
experiences: Explore the medina with a local guide
Leave time to browse craft stalls
Build a city day around your arrival or departure
destinations.planning: A central riad can be reached on foot from a vehicle drop-off point. Share your accommodation before pickup so the meeting point is clear.

destinations.name: Casablanca
destinations.description: An oceanfront introduction to Morocco and a practical starting point for a wider journey.
destinations.body: Casablanca combines an Atlantic setting with the energy of a large working city. It can be a first stop before heading north to Chefchaouen or inland toward Fes.
experiences: See the oceanfront around the Hassan II Mosque
Enjoy a relaxed arrival night before a long drive
Connect a northern route with an airport transfer
destinations.planning: Interior mosque visits depend on opening arrangements and tickets. Share your arrival time before planning sightseeing or a long onward drive.

destinations.name: Mhamid & the Draa Valley
destinations.description: Palm-lined valleys and desert hospitality at the end of the southern road.
destinations.body: The journey to Mhamid follows the Draa Valley into southern desert country. A stay near Mhamid and an expedition to Erg Chegaga are different experiences, requiring different amounts of time.
experiences: Break the journey with stops in the Draa Valley
Share tea and settle into a desert overnight
Add days for a separately arranged Erg Chegaga excursion
destinations.planning: Marrakech to Mhamid is a long journey. Two days means substantial driving; additional nights allow more stops and time in the desert.
